SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    STDDEV_POP(cpu_percent)    as cpu_percent_1,
    -1*STDDEV_POP(cpu_percent) as cpu_percent_2,
    STDDEV_POP(heap_used_mb)    as heap_used_1,
    -1*STDDEV_POP(heap_used_mb) as heap_used_2,
    STDDEV_POP(memory_rss_mb)    as memory_rss_1,
    -1*STDDEV_POP(memory_rss_mb) as memory_rss_2,
    STDDEV_POP(array_buffers_mb)    as array_buffers_1,
    -1*STDDEV_POP(array_buffers_mb) as array_buffers_2,
    STDDEV_POP(external_mb)    as external_memory_1,
    -1*STDDEV_POP(external_mb) as external_memory_2
FROM node_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN COUNT(DISTINCT host_name)
    ELSE 0
  END as `machines running`,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(host_name,instance_id))
    ELSE 0
  END as `processes running`,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 > 0 
    THEN MAX(logstamp-timestamp)
    ELSE 0
  END as `Max log drift`,
  CASE
    WHEN 2 > 0 
    THEN AVG(logstamp-timestamp)
    ELSE 0
  END as `Average log drift`
FROM node_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(logstamp)

WITH ranked_values AS (
  SELECT
    host_name as possible_values
  FROM node_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY host_name
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
time_series_data AS (
  SELECT 
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
    host_name as host_name,
    AVG(cpu_percent) as value
  FROM node_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ${query0}
  GROUP BY time_bucket, host_name
  ORDER BY value ASC
)
SELECT 
  time_bucket,
  value as " ",
  CASE 
    WHEN host_name IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values) 
    THEN host_name 
    ELSE 'OTHER' 
  END as possible_values
FROM time_series_data
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, value ASC

WITH required_data AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    CONCAT(host_name,' ',instance_id) AS possible_values,
    uptime_sec AS value
  FROM node_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),

ranked_values AS (
  SELECT possible_values
  FROM required_data
  GROUP BY possible_values
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
),

time_series_data AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('minute', timestamp) as time,
    possible_values,
    AVG(value) as value
  FROM required_data
  GROUP BY time, possible_values
  ORDER BY value ASC
)
SELECT 
  time,
  value as " ",
  CASE 
    WHEN possible_values IN (SELECT possible_values FROM ranked_values) 
    THEN possible_values 
    ELSE 'OTHER' 
  END as possible_values
FROM time_series_data
ORDER BY time ASC, value ASC

WITH required_data AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    CONCAT(method, ' ', path) AS route,
    event_loop_utilization AS elu,
    request_duration_ms / 1000.0 AS duration_s
  FROM node_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    ${query0}
),

ranked_routes AS (
  SELECT route
  FROM required_data
  GROUP BY route
  ORDER BY SUM(duration_s * elu) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),

time_series_data AS (
  SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) AS time_bucket,
    route,
    SUM(duration_s * elu) AS impact
  FROM required_data
  GROUP BY time_bucket, route
)

SELECT
  time_bucket,
  impact AS " ",
  CASE
    WHEN route IN (SELECT route FROM ranked_routes)
    THEN route
    ELSE 'OTHER'
  END AS route
FROM time_series_data
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, impact ASC

WITH ordered_calls AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)    AS time_bucket,
        CONCAT(method, ' ', path)                           AS route,
        old_space_used_mb,
        heap_limit_mb,

        lagInFrame(old_space_used_mb) OVER (
            PARTITION BY CONCAT(method, ' ', path)
            ORDER BY timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_memory_same_route,

        lagInFrame(old_space_used_mb) OVER (
            ORDER BY timestamp
            ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
        ) AS prev_memory_global

    FROM node_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),

with_delta AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket,
        route,
        old_space_used_mb,
        heap_limit_mb,
        (old_space_used_mb - prev_memory_same_route)  AS delta_mb,
        prev_memory_global                             AS baseline_before_call,
        (heap_limit_mb - prev_memory_global)           AS free_before_call
    FROM ordered_calls
    WHERE
        prev_memory_same_route IS NOT NULL
        AND prev_memory_global IS NOT NULL
        AND (old_space_used_mb - prev_memory_same_route) > 0
)

SELECT
    time_bucket,
    route,
    round(avg(delta_mb), 2)                                          AS avg_delta_mb,
    round(max(delta_mb), 2)                                          AS max_delta_mb,
    count()                                                          AS request_count,
    round(avg(baseline_before_call), 1)                              AS avg_baseline_mb,
    round(max(old_space_used_mb), 1)                                 AS peak_after_call,
    round(avg(heap_limit_mb), 0)                                     AS heap_limit_mb,
    round(avg(delta_mb) / nullIf(avg(free_before_call), 0) * 100, 1) AS pct_headroom_consumed,
    countIf(delta_mb > 30)                                           AS spike_events

FROM with_delta
GROUP BY time_bucket, route
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, pct_headroom_consumed DESC

WITH route_memory AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) AS time_bucket,
        CONCAT(method, ' ', path) AS route,
        max(old_space_used_mb) AS max_old_space_mb
    FROM node_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    GROUP BY time_bucket, route
)
SELECT
    time_bucket,
    route,
    max_old_space_mb,
    CASE WHEN max_old_space_mb > 0.8 * (SELECT max(heap_limit_mb) FROM node_metrics LIMIT 1)
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS memory_alert
FROM route_memory
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC

WITH route_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) AS time_bucket,
        CONCAT(method, ' ', path) AS route,
        SUM((request_duration_ms / 1000.0) * event_loop_utilization) AS elu_impact,
        quantileExact(0.95)(request_duration_ms) AS p95_latency_ms
    FROM node_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
        ${query0}
    GROUP BY time_bucket, route
)
SELECT
    time_bucket,
    route,
    elu_impact,
    p95_latency_ms,
    CASE
        WHEN elu_impact > 0.3 AND p95_latency_ms > 200 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS alert
FROM route_metrics
ORDER BY time_bucket ASC

panels.title: Grafana / ClickHouse Query for ELU + p95 spike

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN server.connections_accepted > 0 
    THEN ROUND((server.connections_accepted - server.connections_handled) * 100.0 / server.connections_accepted, 2)
    ELSE 0 
  END as `DROP RATE %`,
  CASE 
    WHEN server.connections_active > 0 
    THEN ROUND(server.connections_writing * 100.0 / server.connections_active, 2)
    ELSE 0 
  END as `CONN READ UTILIZATION %`,
  CASE 
    WHEN server.connections_active > 0 
    THEN ROUND(server.connections_writing * 100.0 / server.connections_active, 2)
    ELSE 0 
  END as `CONN WRITE UTILIZATION %`,
  CASE 
    WHEN server.connections_active > 0 
    THEN ROUND(server.connections_waiting * 100.0 / server.connections_active, 2) 
    ELSE 0 
  END as `CONN WAITING UTILIZATION %`
FROM kong_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(logstamp) ${query0}

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(logstamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
  server.connections_accepted as `REACHED SYSCALL ACCEPT()`,
  server.connections_handled as `SUCCESSFUL RETURN FROM ACCEPT()`,
  server.connections_accepted - server.connections_handled as `CONNECTIONS DROPPED`
FROM kong_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(logstamp) ${query0}
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC

SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(logstamp, INTERVAL ${interval} ${bucket}) as time_bucket,
  server.connections_active as  `CONCURRENT TCP CONNECTIONS`,
  server.connections_reading as `CLIENT -> KONG (RECEIVING)`,
  server.connections_writing as `KONG -> CLIENT (SENDING)`, 
  server.connections_waiting as `IDLE (WAITING)`
FROM kong_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(logstamp) ${query0}
ORDER BY time_bucket DESC
